simple.summary: חוֹף (chôwph) means a cove (as a sheltered bay) First listed occurrence: Deut 1 7.

definitions.usage: coast (of the sea), haven, shore, (sea-) side.
definitions.full: H2348. choph חוֺף noun [masculine] shore, coast (as surrounding, enclosing ) — ׳ח only construct Gen 49:13 (twice in verse) + 5 t.: — shore of sea ׳ח הַיָּם Deut 1:7 ; Josh 9:1 (both D), Judg 5:17 ; Jer 47:7 ; Ezek 25:16 ; ׳ח יַמִּים Gen 49:13 (poem); אֳנִיּוֺת ׳ח 49:13 the shore of ships , i.e. to which ships come.
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to cover;
